Condition : 3 - Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, tree protection measures detailed in the Arboricultural Impact Assessment and Arboricultural Method Statement (February 2017) shall be implemented and retained during the construction.

Condition : 4 - Within one month of the removal of the development hereby approved, full details of the size, species and location of the replacement tree shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The replacement tree(s) shall be planted as soon as possible and no later than the end of the next planting season (November to March). The replacement tree(s) shall be automatically covered by the existing Tree Preservation Order and shall be maintained. Should the replacement tree(s) die or become seriously damaged or moribund, then a further replacement tree(s) to the same specification shall be planted immediately. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - The development herby approved shall not be occupied until the ecological mitigation measures and biodiversity enhancement measures recommended in Preliminary Ecological Appraisal (February 2017) and the Letter prepared by Barton Willmore dated 23 March 2017 have been implemented. These measures shall be maintained for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 7 - The lifting of the temporary teaching accommodation hereby approved onto the site from Twickenham Road shall not be carried out outside of the following times: 20:00 - 06:00 without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Before the development hereby approved is first occupied, the developer shall provide secure covered cycle parking in the location shown on the approved plans for no less than forty-four bicycles. The approved facilities shall conform the Transport for London 'London Cycling Design Standards' in design and layout.

Condition : 9 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the submitted Deliveries and Servicing Plan - Temporary Accommodation March 2017, prepared by Robert West, and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used. Deliveries shall be monitored on an on-going basis and if unauthorised on-street deliveries take place immediate and pro-active measures shall be used to prevent such unauthorised deliveries.

Condition : 10 - Prior to first occupation of the development, the existing northern most vehicular crossover on Twickenham Road is to be permanently closed with kerbs and footway reinstated and appropriate guard railings installed.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place until a Construction Management Plan (CMP)
and Construction Logistics Plan (CLP) have been submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The CMP and CLP shall cover as a minimum:

-	a site plan (showing the areas set out below)
-	confirmation that a pre-start record of site conditions on the adjoining public highway will be undertaken with Hounslow Highways and a commitment to repair any damage caused
-	provision for the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors
-	provisions for loading, unloading and storage of plant and materials within the site
-	details of access to the site, including the submission of vehicle tracking to ensure all vehicles can safely access the site, means to control and manage access and egress of vehicles to and from the site for the duration of construction to ensure road safety and free-flow of traffic is not compromised, and any phasing arrangements
-	details of vehicle routeing from the site to the wider strategic road network
-	the erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate
-	provision of wheel washing facilities at the site exit and a commitment to sweep adjacent roads when required and at the reasonable request of the council
-	a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works
-	measures to ensure the safety of all users of the public highway especially cyclists and pedestrians in the vicinity of the site and especially at the access
-	commitment to liaise with other contractors in the vicinity of the site to
-	maximise the potential for consolidation and to minimise traffic impacts
-	details of delivery hours in accordance with council requirements but to include as a minimum the avoidance of network and school peak hours for deliveries and details of a booking system to avoid vehicles waiting on the public highway
-	all necessary traffic or
Condition : 12 - Prior to the occupation of the development, school keep clear markings along Twickenham Road shall be procured.

Condition : 13 - Prior to first occupation, the development shall be connected to the Thames Water combined sewer network to discharge surface water from the site, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of development.

Condition : 14 - a)	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.

b)	If required, prior to first occupation the agreed scheme for decontamination referred to above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
description: Installation of temporary teaching accommodation including provision of additional hardstanding, landscape works, cycle parking, a temporary extension to the access steps to the rear of Busch House School and installation of a temporary platform lift.
